title: Contract formation and civil-rights claims
summary: The legal significance of formation can extend beyond a claim for breach.
notes: Perry’s procedural remand examined when a salon appointment became a contract under the then-existing interpretation of § 1981. The book immediately explains that the 1991 amendment extended the provision to performance, modification, termination, and enjoyment of contractual benefits. That historical limitation must not be taught as the later statute’s coverage. The Barfield change-making example asks whether the bank transaction contained consideration; the assigned passage presents the question without a full resolution.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 236–238. Open assigned page 236.
